confidence.rationale: Patch identity, base tree, all after-images, ordered tuples, mocked command journal, checker source, and workflow needs graph were inspected; the remaining Linux gap is explicit.

evidencePlan.action: Commit the exact three-path candidate, then run profile-contract-models and the profile/full Linux workflow without changing 180 seconds, 256, or 2 MiB limits.
evidencePlan.question: Does the exact integrated head satisfy the source contract and Linux formatter/runtime gates?

impact.rationale: The patch changes diagnostic CI admission and formatter coverage, so an error can waste or misclassify a full diagnostic run but cannot alter production behavior or persistent state.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: One new path is omitted, replaced, duplicated, or reordered in either side.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Producer and reader use the same duplicate-free ordered 25-path FULL_FMT tuple.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The independent expected tuple is exact, both modules are compared against it, len and uniqueness are pinned, and delete, replace, and reorder variants are rejected.
materialBoundaries.runtimeRoot: profile_evidence FORMAT command and check_profile command receipt reader

materialBoundaries.invariant: The producer actually invokes gofmt -d with the exact 25 paths and preserves the Go command contract.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The CPU model mocks Popen, reads commands.jsonl, and exact-compares FORMAT and GO_TEST argv; source inspection confirms the reader builds its expected argv from unchanged FULL_FMT and FULL_GO_ARGS.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: The new job exists but profile or full can run without it.
materialBoundaries.invariant: The CPU source-contract model gates both Linux profile jobs.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: profile and full each explicitly need development-only and profile-contract-models; downstream fresh jobs remain transitively dependent.

materialBoundaries.invariant: The integrated exact head is format-clean and behaves correctly on Linux without claiming the open timeout is fixed.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: A final-head workflow replay can independently run the model, producer, reader, formatter, and Go diagnostics while preserving 180 seconds and existing limits.
